title: OthouMod
description: Survival QOL Mod made for a friend
body:
# Purpose of the mod

This mod was made for a friend who needed some Quality of Life features.

# Features

- Enderman won't grief the world
- Ability to open chests and barrels through item frames
- Ability to leash Villagers
- Displays the day count at the top-left corner of the screen
- /compact command that crafts the block version of the item in hand
- Keybind for the above command that behaves differently depending on the context:
  - In the world, pressing the key will trigger the /compact command
  - In an inventory, pressing the key will trigger /compact on the item being hovered over
